name: manual_bd8505
claim: Mac↔Win cross-harness E2E verification requires an actual curl probe: curl -s --max-time 5 http://${WIN_IP}:1234/v1/models — the start.sh --hardware-policy flag only validates openclaw.json config, it does NOT probe the live Win LM Studio endpoint.

decisions.notes: During 2026-06-28 Mac session, --hardware-policy showed 'openclaw.json clean' but the real cross-probe (curl to Win IP) was a separate manual step. The distinction matters for the T5 gate: both are required for full E2E green.
